newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: ABB wins 2.28 bln peso Philippine contract.
newsitem.headline: ABB wins 2.28 bln peso Philippine contract.

text.p: The Philippines' state-owned National Power Corporation said on Wednesday it awarded ABB Sae Sadelmi a 2.282 billion peso turn-key contract to build a high voltage transmission line in the northern island of Luzon.
The signing of the contract was due later today, Napocor President Guido Delgado told reporters.
Delgado said the project named "Northwestern Luzon extra high voltage transmission lines" will entail the establishment of a 500 kilovolt power transmission network.
It will help bring 1,000-mw of power from the Sual power plant in the northern province of Pangasinan to the grid.
Napocor also awarded a contract worth 1.082 billion pesos for construction of one of the towers to North East China Electric Power Import Export Corp.
